name: ucc
description: Unified Collective Communication (UCC) is a collective communication operations API and library for high-performance computing and machine learning applications.

cuda.description: Enable CUDA transports (TL CUDA, MC CUDA, EC CUDA) using the installed CUDA Toolkit found by the cuda port (requires CUDA >= 11.0 with nvcc and NVML)

ibverbs.description: Enable libibverbs-based transport support (requires the rdma-core runtime and RDMA hardware)

nccl.description: Enable the NCCL transport using the system NCCL found by the nccl port (requires CUDA >= 11.0 and an installed NCCL)

nvls.description: Compile the NVLink SHARP (NVLS) TL CUDA algorithms (requires CUDA >= 12.0 at build time; runtime needs NVSwitch datacenter hardware with multicast support)

rdmacm.description: Enable librdmacm connection-manager support (requires the rdma-core runtime)
